title: Apache Commons Statistics: finite bounds, NaN probabilities, and a changed decision
summary: Rounded-log cancellation in LogUniformDistribution 1.3 produces invalid probabilities for narrow finite intervals. Across 176 distinct inputs, a GERO synthetic worksheet makes 30 wrong threshold decisions; a local candidate removes them and restoring the original restores them.
limits: Official release API executed; full current master and upstream suite not built. Candidate only, no complete moments/inverse/sampling validation or correctly rounded guarantee. Synthetic consumer, no measured deployed/customer/security impact.
measured_chain: Rounded-log cancellation -> NaN survival probability -> synthetic CSV/JSON worksheet -> 30 incorrect unguarded decisions or 30 blocked guarded calculations; candidate0, restored30.
